name: Moving Platform Test
design_intent: VALIDATION SANDBOX for the moving_platform mechanic (v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md §2.6). NOT a shipping arena — a driveable smoke-test bed. A wide static trampoline FLOOR catches anyone who falls (no deaths mid-test), and a single horizontal VEHICLE deck (MovingPlatform, an AnimatableBody2D that CARRIES riders via a top-sensor sticky delta) oscillates ~1000px side-to-side well ABOVE the floor. All four player_spawns sit ON the deck so at COMBAT the players rest on it and ride along — proving solid collision (rest, no tunnel) + velocity-transfer carry (no jitter). A rider knocked off simply drops to the safety floor. Symmetric spawns; the deck is pure footing (never kills).
